Name: Front Door Rasmodius - Wizard Intro Restoration for SVE
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
[size=4]A GRAVE INJUSTICE, RECTIFIED[/size]

For years, we accepted it. We told ourselves it was fine. We looked away.

When the Farmer is first introduced to M. Rasmodius (seeker of the arcane truths, mediary between physical and ethereal, master of the seven elementals), they witness him vanish from his tower in a flash of magic to check on the Golden Scroll. And then, having deciphered the content within, walk back in through the front door like some mundane person returning from the corner store.

This is not a bug, nay, and neither is it a plot hole. This is the game telling you that the teleportation was never necessary. Time was not of the essence, and he was perfectly capable of traveling with his legs. Did he run out of magic? Or was he thinking of getting some cardio in? We don't know, but we still feel its meaning: that the contrast is the point. It gives him character and, most importantly, is funny as all heck.

SVE took that away from him.

There, the Wizard teleports out, and then, tragically, also teleports back in. Consistent? Yes. Dramatic? Sure. But at what cost? A great sorcerer is now stripped of his one perfect moment of bathos in the name of looking cooler. It is, frankly, a character assassination.

No longer.

This mod restores what was stolen. It restores the walk. It restores the door opening. It restores the moment where the Wizard, having made his grand and unnecessary exit, simply comes home like the rest of us. That is the Wizard. That is our Wizard.

Walk through that front door, Rasmodius. You may not need to, but you — and us all — deserve it.



(To be clear: SVE is a massive undertaking and I don't say any of this to diminish that. This is basically just a nitpick about one teleport animation.)

Manifest.Name: Front Door Rasmodius
Manifest.Description: Makes the Wizard from SVE, walk through the front door like he does in vanilla.
